note: Work here refers to economic activities (employment and production of goods). Household chores such as cooking, cleaning, and childcare are not included. Does not include the worst forms of child labor that cannot be measured through surveys (trafficking, forced labor, etc.). Shares may not sum to 100% due to rounding.
